title: Selling digital products changed my life! (5 steps to get started in 2026)
summary: Stay-at-home mom says Etsy printables earned her thousands without ads or social media and sells a course built on keyword research, copying bestseller listings and SEO.

assertions.quote: I've been able to make over $27,000 selling digital products as a stay-at-home mom.

verdicts.note: Most Etsy shops earn very little, and digital printables are flooded with resold templates, so one seller's results don't carry over to most parents.

assertions.quote: create something once that would make sales while I was doing laundry, cooking dinner, or even sleeping.
There was no inventory, no sleazy DM convos.
So, we don't have to worry about building our own audience.
we already get the built-in traffic of people going to Etsy
model your listing photos after that because that is what's working.
optimize your listings for search engine optimization and you won't have to rely on ads or social media to make sales

verdicts.note: Marketplace search does drive organic sales, but keyword-tool competition scores are rough and the low-competition gaps fill quickly.

assertions.quote: do not create your products from scratch if you do not have to. Use templates and make the process so much easier

verdicts.note: PLR templates do cut creation time, though the same templates go to many sellers, so the listings are hard to tell apart.

assertions.quote: we tend to make a lot more money during October, November, and December

verdicts.note: US retail and e-commerce sales follow a well-documented seasonal peak from October through December.
